title: Supreme Court: Hughes v. Northwestern Univ.
summary: Determining whether plan participants state plausible claims against plan fiduciaries for violations of ERISA’s duty of prudence requires a context-specific inquiry of the fiduciaries’ continuing duty to monitor investments and to remove imprudent ones as articulated in Tibble v. Edison Int’l, 575 U. S. 523; the Seventh Circuit erred in relying on the participants’ ultimate choice over their investments to excuse allegedly imprudent decisions by respondents. (No. 19-1401, opinion by Justice Sotomayor; 595 U.S. 170).

title: Supreme Court: Hemphill v. New York
summary: The trial court’s admission—over Hemphill’s objection—of the plea allocution transcript of an unavailable witness violated Hemphill’s Sixth Amendment right to confront the witnesses against him. (No. 20-637, opinion by Justice Sotomayor; 595 U.S. 140).

title: Supreme Court: NFIB v. OSHA
summary: The Court grants the applications to stay the Occupational Safety & Health Administration’s challenged rule mandating that employers with at least 100 employees require covered workers to receive a COVID–19 vaccine. (No. 21A244, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 595 U.S. 109).

title: Supreme Court: Biden v. Missouri
summary: The Court grants the applications to stay the two injunctions barring the Secretary of Health and Human Services’ regulation requiring facilities that participate in Medicare and Medicaid to ensure that their employees are vaccinated against COVID–19. (No. 21A240, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 595 U.S. 87).

title: Supreme Court: Babcock v. Kijakazi
summary: Civil-service pension payments based on employment as a dual-status military technician are not payments based on “service as a member of a uniformed service” under 42 U. S. C. §415(a)(7)(A)(III). (No. 20-480, opinion by Justice Barrett; 595 U.S. 77).

title: Lakota Corporation (Lakota Trailers): Tire Belt Separation (100 affected)
summary: Lakota Corporation (Lakota) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Bighorn, Charger, and Livestock trailers equipped with certain Sailun tires, size ST235/80R16/G.   Due to a manufacturing issue, the tires may experience a belt separation.

title: Reading Truck Group LLC: Subframe Rear Pivot Mount Weld May Fail (299 affected)
summary: Reading Truck Body, LLC (Reading) is recalling certain 2017-2021 Marauder Landscape Dump Body vehicles.  The dump body hoist subframe rear pivot mount weld may fail.

title: Play-Mor Trailers, Inc.: Propane Regulator May Fail and Cause Fire (42 affected)
summary: Play-Mor Trailers, Inc. (Play-Mor) is recalling certain 2017-2020 3 Room Actor, 2 Room Actor, 2 Room Office, Hair and Makeup, Restroom, 2020 Single Actor, 2019-2020 Motorsport SUV, and 2017 199 Camping Trailer, and Custom BBQ trailers equipped with Winntec model 6020 two-stage propane regulators. title: Oshkosh Corporation: Fuel Tubes May Crack and Leak Fuel (1,608 affected)

title: Seagrave Fire Apparatus, LLC: Crossmember Mounting Plate May Crack (409 affected)

title: Ford Motor Company: Brake Light Malfunction and Possible Rollaway Risk (199,085 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2014-2015 Fusion, Lincoln MKZ, and 2015 Mustang vehicles originally sold or ever registered, in Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, North Carolina, Virginia and Hawaii. title: Volta Power Systems LLC: Wire Harness Built Incorrectly (646 affected)

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Rim Information on Label/FMVSS 120 (82 affected)
